header: What our editors published this month
subheadline: Notes from the desks behind The Northstar Quarterly, Signal Weekly and the Lodestar archive. Four issues a year leaves a great deal happening in between, and this is where the working notes end up.

posts.title: Reading a paper twice, once for the data
posts.excerpt: Mira Kovac walks through the second pass every quantitative submission gets, and the three checks that catch most of what the first pass misses.

posts.title: Colour proofing 4,200 copies in one day
posts.excerpt: Lena Osei on the press routine in Vienna: plate checks at 07:00, first clean sheets by 09:30, and the one page that always needs a second pass.

posts.title: Permissions in five days, not five weeks
posts.excerpt: Hanna Lindqvist rebuilt the rights desk around a single intake form. Requests now leave with a decision inside five working days.
